name: Miura Natsue
source:
She is a very healthy woman who grew up in the great outdoors.

She is very uninhibited sexually, and has sex with anyone she feels like.

She has a strong interest in Seiichi, who is not part of the village, and who exudes a sense of intelligence.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/inen/]official site[/url]]
